system.description:
Wide river basins and floodplains, flat and wet. Boats carry the goods, and every settlement sits on a bank. Floods come every few years and wash the old boundaries away, so people learn to trade, bargain, and start over.

Talent: one Finesse die to d10, one Presence die to d10.

  • River Walk. You learn the River Walk Technique (Innate). Evade: move up to 20 feet without spending the Disengage Quick Action or provoking an Attack of Opportunity.
  • Bartering Culture. +3 Training in Guile.
